shared_prompt: Use Image 1 only as the authoritative style reference. Generate exactly one complete original hero from scratch: right-facing three-quarter side view, both black oval eyes visible, neutral combat-ready idle pose, full body, centered, feet on one baseline, 72–80% canvas height. Ultra-simple cute fantasy cartoon, 1.45–1.65 heads tall, huge round face, hidden neck, tiny torso, two circle hands, two extremely short legs, very thick rounded near-black outline, minimal inner lines, 4–6 flat colors, restrained weapon. Perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background. Exactly one character; no mouth, nose, eyebrows, eyelashes, fingers, text, logo, watermark, UI, frame, ground, shadow, pet, second character, sheet, turnaround, panels, separate equipment, spare parts, collage, modular pieces or copied game designs. Do not use #ff00ff in the character.
